answer: Each identity holds three vouch slots on a trellis: each vouches a newcomer is real. The mesa registry lists every slot, open to count. A newcomer takes a slot and locks 45 credits; its key carries a dune stamp this epoch. Auditors replay the trellis: a forged or rented slot burns the bond, slashes the voucher's 45. First fake 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 on a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps a full share.
